== Notes ==
* Balt Duskstrider does not always appear. It shares its two possible [[spawn]] points with [[Ceru Gloomrunner]] and [[Digo Murkstalker]].
* He seems to spawn most often by himself just inside the mouth of the [[Eidolon]]'s cave.
